events.text:
I removed the duplicate `procurement-ops@halcyon.example` entry from `notify`. That was the only change.

I left `second_approval_threshold` at 9500 on purpose. AP-7 sets the limit at $10,000 but allows procurement to set stricter thresholds. Kwame lowered it in March 2025 after audit finding IA-114, which found purchases split to stay just under $10,000. Changing it back to 10000 would undo that control, so the config already complies with AP-7.

If you still want the threshold at 10000, Kwame would need to approve that.
